public_inputs: measurement NPZ contains only complex y; config and frozen options; no truth or digit ID parameter

original_main_FWI_evidence: nine actual B0 endpoints and required arrays/traces/runtime receipts verified in results/B0_FULL_FWI/B0_COST_AND_NONCONVERGENCE.json

array_formats.canonical_endpoint_npz: target_contrast and target_loss separate; wall_eps and wall_loss separate; target x/y edges retained
array_formats.research_FWI_complete_outputs_wall_npy: (ny,nx,2): real wall epsilon, loss coefficient ell
array_formats.deploy_artifacts_save_outputs_target_npy: (ny,nx) complex contrast + i*ell, documented by RUN_ALGORITHM.md deployment section
array_formats.frequency_convention: permittivity imaginary component is ell/f; ell-array is coefficient, not arbitrary-frequency imaginary epsilon
